preconditions.message: Open the MCA portal (www.mca.gov.in) in this tab first.
Log in to MCA first. VCFO Assist does not log in for you.

steps.label: MCA Services
steps.message: In the MCA top menu, open MCA Services. Then press Continue.

steps.label: Company e-Filing
steps.message: Under MCA Services, open Company e-Filing. Then press Continue.

steps.label: Incorporation & Changes
steps.message: Under Company e-Filing, open Incorporation & Change services. Then press Continue.

steps.label: SPICe+
steps.message: Click "SPICe+ Form - Reserve name for new company incorporation". Press Continue once the SPICe+ page starts loading.

steps.reason: Pick the NIC row from the popup table yourself, review every field, then submit yourself. VCFO Assist does not submit.
